data.description: Adds the Ruby Golem, an animated mob that roams forests.
data.name: Custom mob

meta.notes: The mod metadata, written to fabric.mod.json when you export the Fabric mod jar. New mobs exist only in that jar, which also needs Fabric API, msm_runtime and GeckoLib (both nested in the jar unless you choose to keep them separate). The mod id must stay unique among the mods you install.
